scope: Independent immutable-request record serialization and placement-length authority for the existing ACE16 ordinary-variable engineering preview; no combined API.
counting_policy: 11 private (3 prior +8 new) +11 existing integration +11 existing consumer =33 distinct. Repeated causal/diagnostic/retry executions are excluded. Three doctests are separate.

source_context.scope: Ten selected Rust files only, not a full compiler closure or frozen artifact. Root owns map_audit.rs and map_audit/tests.rs; all other scoped implementation/test changes belong to this record. Existing fixture inputs/expected image goldens and dependencies/manifests/public APIs are unchanged.
source_context.continuity: All ten source pins were verified unchanged after final bounded checks. No Rust edits after the final batch snapshot.
source_context.resource_policy: Additional original-root traversal, decoding, expected-record storage, wire encoding, byte comparisons and page audit are paid; exact limit/cancellation thresholds can tighten.

implementation.binding: Operation holds original table/column/request slice. Finalizer checks original table, rebinds selected field and recaptures physical-order exclusive original roots. It validates expected values and complete layout before excluding semantic noops.
implementation.serialization: Independent preferred encoder validates actual carriers and metadata. Text compresses only when flag enabled, UTF16 count>2 and all units1..255. Two-unit tie raw; NULL/present empty distinct masks. Reader decoder proves requested Text roundtrip. No builder/replace_payload/exact-slot encoder is used as certification authority.
implementation.geometry: Lnew=max(L,E-selected_span+preferred_payload+original_footer). Preserve original physical C, actual stored V/all offsets/historical slots, whole masks and stationary unused padding; update only actual selected physical-number bit. Smaller readable physical C remains writer refusal.
implementation.records: Audit-owned ChangedRecord carries root/reference/word/range, original final offset/capacity and exact reconstructed bytes. No plan/event input supplies these facts. Verified compares exact count/order/identity, fitted offset, branch, target size and all record bytes.
implementation.placement: Root map audit independently derives lengths from certified bytes and original capacity, replays original highest-hint geometry, failed fits, represented EOF and exact original-before/current-after owned/hint/global union. Event target length no longer grants authority.
implementation.final_checks: Existing page audit is also rerun inside finalizer. Original-prefix protection, exact maps, actual grown catalog/table/index/constraint and membership checks remain. Existing admission/ordinary-root zeroing and forwarded/retired-hidden preservation policies are unchanged.
